cd tests/fuzz

# Download the seed corpora
make -j seedcorpora
# Build all of the fuzzers
./fuzz.py build all

for target in $(./fuzz.py list); do
    cp "$target" "$OUT"

    if [ -f "$target.dict" ]; then
        cp "$target.dict" "$OUT"
    fi

    cp "corpora/${target}_seed_corpus.zip" "$OUT"
done
